chunks: Zurārah, Muḥammad ibn Muslim, and al-Fuḍayl asked Abū Jaʿfar al-Bāqir and Abā ʿAbdillāh al-Ṣādiq عليهما السلام about supererogatory prayer at night in the month of Ramadan in congregation.

They both said: “The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله used to, when he had performed the last night prayer, return to his home. Then he would come out in the latter part of the night to the mosque and stand and pray. So he came out on the first night of the month of Ramadan to pray as he used to pray, and the people lined up behind him. He fled from them to his house and left them. They did that for three nights. Then on the third day, he صلى الله عليه وآله stood upon his pulpit, praised Allah and extolled Him, then said: ‘O people, prayer by night in the month of Ramadan from the supererogatory prayers in congregation is an innovation, and the Duḥā prayer is an innovation. Lo, do not gather by night in the month of Ramadan for the night prayer, and do not perform the Duḥā prayer, for that is an act of disobedience. Lo, every innovation is misguidance, and every misguidance, its path is to the Fire.’”
Then he صلى الله عليه وآله descended while saying: ‘A little in sunnah (prophetic tradition) is better than much in innovation.’

key_terms.النَّارِ: the Fire, the consequence stated for misguidance
key_terms.بِدْعَةٌ: innovation in religion, introduced practice not sanctioned in the sunnah (prophetic tradition)
key_terms.جَمَاعَةً: in congregation, praying as a group behind an Imam
key_terms.سُنَّةٍ: the prophetic tradition and normative practice to be followed
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the context for the ruling discussed
key_terms.صَلَاةَ الضُّحَى: the forenoon prayer mentioned here as an innovation

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about performing night prayers in congregation during Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith relates a ruling from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, transmitted by Imam al-Baqir and Imam al-Sadiq عليهما السلام, concerning supererogatory night prayer in congregation during the month of Ramadan. It presents such congregational nawafil as bidʿah and emphasizes adherence to sunnah (prophetic tradition), even if little, over abundance in innovation.
